title: Construct and prove the ARE multi-cycle evolution runtime
outcome: Construct and prove one small ARE-native runtime in which agents use a closed versioned JSON protocol while the runtime owns reconstructible state, generated data, evidence, accounting, receipts, recovery, bounded work admission, and typed handoffs for independently defined evolution cycles, delivering the GLM 8K ContextBench H-EN benchmark-research vertical first without turning benchmark evidence or recommendations into activation authority.
rationale: ARE already contains a bounded evolution-runtime mechanism and evidence for measured evolution, but benchmark history, research work, engine improvement, interaction learning, and controlled upgrade need one coherent runtime boundary. A dedicated Goal keeps that construction distinct from the continuous-construction task-loop Goal, preserves cycle-specific meaning, and makes safe H-EN benchmark resumption the first useful vertical rather than waiting for the entire multi-cycle surface.
scope: the existing parent Product Capability CA2-CAP-REASON-AND-MANAGE-CONTEXT, specialized through its measured-evolution policy and evolution-runtime realization binding without creating a new Product Capability
one extension of the existing ARE evolution-runtime rather than a competing runtime
one closed versioned JSON command, event, receipt, artifact, envelope, admission, handoff, and cycle-definition protocol
one append-only event authority with aggregate cycle, subordinate-record, and executable-work projections
one reconstructible storage model using durable ledgers, a global content-addressed object store, and a disposable SQLite operational index
five independently admitted cycle-definition candidates: benchmark research, research learning, engine improvement, interaction learning, and controlled upgrade
one first benchmark-research vertical that reconstructs the current GLM 8K ContextBench H-EN candidate and qualifies an exact next experiment
one space-first evidence lifecycle with global deduplication, warm compression, verified cold archives, and hash-verified restoration
exclusions: changing the existing continuous-construction task-loop Goal
treating benchmark research as the universal evolution lifecycle
allowing agents, workers, adapters, indexes, or imported status files to assign authoritative state directly
synthesizing missing historical evidence, chronology, accounting, or receipts
persisting provider credentials, access tokens, or other secrets
automatic cycle-definition admission, provider use, benchmark execution, engine activation, permanent evidence deletion, publication, release, deployment, or external effects
claiming Goal achievement from planning, schema validation, tests, or artifact creation alone
owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Agent Reasoning Engine Project owner plus Agent Reasoning Engine product-meaning, evolution-runtime, research, implementation, and operations owners

success_conditions.statement: The Goal has one exact Product Capability carrier and complete D65 construction identities without changing the continuous-construction task-loop Goal.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: The Project and Goal close bidirectionally; the selected Product Capability, Definition Pack, business ontology, DomainSpec source, compiled graph, system ontology, implementation, product candidate, tests, and product decision remain distinct and digest-bound.

success_conditions.statement: The common kernel reconstructs one authoritative event chain and all three projection layers without trusting mutable indexes or direct state assignments.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Closed-protocol, idempotency, stale-revision, crash-point, corruption, replay, index-deletion, rebuild, concurrency, and secret-rejection tests pass against exact frozen bytes.

success_conditions.statement: Work admission, leases, settlement, accounting, recovery, and typed handoffs remain bounded and non-authorizing across cycle types.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Hostile tests prove that no work executes outside its current phase admission, every admitted attempt settles once, recovery precedes redispatch, and handoffs transfer evidence but never state, credentials, budgets, or authority.

success_conditions.statement: The current GLM 8K ContextBench H-EN frontier is reconstructed exactly and one runtime-native next experiment can be resumed safely.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: A retrospective import preserves source hashes, chronology, exposure posture, accounting gaps, and missing evidence; independent construction validation, a frozen experiment, operational preflight, a user-approved effect envelope, launch admission, and complete terminal attempt accounting are separately evidenced.

success_conditions.statement: All five admitted cycle definitions conform to the shared kernel without merging their objectives, policies, validators, credentials, states, or authority boundaries.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Each cycle adapter passes common conformance plus cycle-specific transition, recovery, hostile-boundary, and non-authorizing-handoff tests; controlled upgrade additionally proves separate-process and credential isolation without performing live activation.

success_conditions.statement: The evidence lifecycle reduces hot-storage use without weakening identity, navigation, reconstruction, or deletion controls.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Measured deduplication, compression, archive eligibility, interrupted-pack recovery, bit-rot detection, pin/reference races, and full restoration tests reproduce original hashes while permanent evidence deletion remains user-gated.

success_conditions.statement: One immutable tested product candidate is available for a separate product-owner decision.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: The frozen implementation, schemas, definitions, migration manifests, dependencies, toolchains, documentation, complete test evidence, and all unmet or not-evaluable requirements are collected without treating tests as adoption, activation, release, or deployment.

evidence_requirements: The selected Product Capability remains CA2-CAP-REASON-AND-MANAGE-CONTEXT; CA2-CAP-POLICY-ARE-MEASURED-EVOLUTION and CA2-CAP-BIND-ARE-EVOLUTION-RUNTIME are supporting policy and predecessor realization evidence, not separate Product Capabilities or new adoption decisions.
Every durable identity, transition, receipt, artifact binding, test, and handoff must retain exact provenance and content digests.
The predecessor evolution-runtime and historical benchmark evidence remain immutable inputs; a successor cannot rewrite them to claim prospective execution.
Cycle-definition admission, construction authorization, benchmark effect authorization, product approval, and controlled activation remain separate owner decisions.
Operational support blocks only its exact dependent phase and cannot become ambient authority or a serial blocker for unrelated construction.
Open planning questions and their decisions are owned by goals/projects/agent-reasoning-engine/plans/multi-cycle-evolution-runtime/PLAN.md.
target_horizon: H-EN runtime-native benchmark resumption first, followed by the complete tested multi-cycle product candidate; no deployment deadline
